roadmap.title: First raids
roadmap.description: Die once, survive a raid, use a transit, and win a Scav fight.

roadmap.title: Tour and map access
roadmap.description: Finish the Tour story chapter to open every map, then take the map-based discoveries.

roadmap.title: Story chapters
roadmap.description: Play the story chapters after Tour, keeping the Armored case and fragment choices in mind.

roadmap.title: First boss kills
roadmap.description: Kill each boss once in PMC raids.

roadmap.title: Grinds, task lines and challenges
roadmap.description: Repeat boss kills, raid counters, PvP goals, task lines, cultist kills and the Collector quest.

roadmap.title: Endings and Prestige
roadmap.description: Pick an ending in The Ticket, then Prestige to try the other choices.

roadmap.title: Seasonal character
roadmap.description: Play a seasonal character during the season for modifier, league and document goals.

achievements.description: Die in a raid for the first time.
achievements.sortReason: Happens naturally in the first raids.
achievements.summary: Die in a raid for the first time.

steps.text: Enter a raid and die. This unlocks the first time you die.

achievements.description: Survive 300 raids while playing as a PMC
achievements.sortReason: Long raid counter; it builds while you play.
achievements.summary: Survive 300 raids as a PMC.

guide.context: Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Extract alive from 300 PMC raids.

achievements.description: Survive and extract from every location in Tarkov while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Leave every map alive at least once while playing as a PMC.

steps.text: Extract alive from each location once as a PMC. Check the extraction list for each map.

achievements.description: Use the transit from any location
achievements.summary: Use a transit to travel from one location to another during a raid.

steps.text: Wait about 1 minute after the raid starts, then stand in a transit zone on any location until the 20-second timer ends.

achievements.description: Eliminate 30 PMC operatives with a melee weapon while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill 30 enemy PMCs with melee attacks while you play as a PMC.

guide.context: Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill 30 PMCs using only a melee weapon in PMC raids.

achievements.description: Eliminate 50 USEC PMC operatives
achievements.summary: Eliminate 50 USEC PMC operatives.

guide.context: Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill 50 enemy PMCs that belong to the USEC faction.

achievements.description: Eliminate 50 BEAR PMC operatives
achievements.summary: Eliminate 50 BEAR PMC operatives.

guide.context: Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill 50 enemy PMCs that belong to the BEAR faction.

achievements.description: Survive and extract from Interchange through the Scav Co-Op extraction while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: As a PMC, leave @loc{Interchange} alive by taking the Scav Co-Op extraction.

steps.text: Play a PMC raid on @loc{Interchange} and leave through the Scav Co-Op extraction.

achievements.description: Neutralize Killa for the first time while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Eliminate @enemy{Killa} for the first time as a PMC.

guide.context: Only the standard Killa counts. Vengeful Killa in The Labyrinth does not.

steps.text: In a PMC raid on @loc{Interchange}, find and kill @enemy{Killa}. He is in the stores of the ULTRA mall.

achievements.description: Neutralize Tagilla for the first time while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Eliminate @enemy{Tagilla} for the first time as a PMC.

guide.context: Only the standard Tagilla counts. Shadow of Tagilla in The Labyrinth does not.

steps.text: In a PMC raid on @loc{Factory}, find and kill @enemy{Tagilla}. He roams all of Factory and also waits in the Interchange garage under the Goshan store.

achievements.description: Neutralize Shturman for the first time while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Eliminate @enemy{Shturman} for the first time as a PMC.

steps.text: In a PMC raid on @loc{Woods}, find and kill @enemy{Shturman}. He and his guards stay at the sawmill by the big lake in the south.

achievements.description: Neutralize Reshala for the first time while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Eliminate @enemy{Reshala} for the first time as a PMC.

steps.text: In a PMC raid on @loc{Customs}, find and kill @enemy{Reshala}. He is at the Scav base, the dorms or the new gas station.

achievements.description: Neutralize Glukhar for the first time while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Eliminate @enemy{Glukhar} for the first time as a PMC.

steps.text: In a PMC raid on @loc{Reserve}, find and kill @enemy{Glukhar}. He spawns with 6 guards at the storage buildings marked K, the repair building, the barracks, or the underground warehouse.

achievements.description: Neutralize Sanitar for the first time while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Eliminate @enemy{Sanitar} for the first time as a PMC.

steps.text: In a PMC raid on @loc{Shoreline}, find and kill @enemy{Sanitar}. He is at the port and pier area or near the cottages.

achievements.description: Neutralize Kaban for the first time while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Eliminate @enemy{Kaban} for the first time as a PMC.

steps.text: In a PMC raid on @loc{Streets of Tarkov}, find and kill @enemy{Kaban}. He is at the LexOs car dealership, which is full of Claymores.

achievements.displayName: Now There Are Three of Them!
achievements.description: Neutralize Knight, Birdeye, and Big Pipe in a single raid for the first time while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Knight}, @enemy{Birdeye} and @enemy{Big Pipe} within one PMC raid, for the first time.

guide.context: The three Goons are only on one map at a time and change maps every few hours.

steps.text: Find the three Goons together on the map they currently use and kill all three before you leave the raid.

achievements.description: Neutralize Kollontay for the first time while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Eliminate @enemy{Kollontay} for the first time as a PMC.

guide.context: Kollontay's baton jams your weapon when he hits you, so kill his guards first.

steps.text: In a PMC raid on @loc{Streets of Tarkov}, find and kill @enemy{Kollontay}. He is at the Klimov shopping mall or the ministry of the interior academy.

achievements.description: Neutralize Partisan for the first time while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Eliminate @enemy{Partisan} for the first time as a PMC.

steps.text: In a PMC raid on @loc{Customs}, @loc{Woods}, @loc{Shoreline} or @loc{Lighthouse}, find and kill @enemy{Partisan}. He has no fixed spot, so expect him anywhere on those maps.

achievements.description: Neutralize Killa 15 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Killa} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Killa} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.description: Neutralize Tagilla 15 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Tagilla} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Tagilla} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.description: Neutralize Shturman 15 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Shturman} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Shturman} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.description: Neutralize Reshala 15 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Reshala} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Reshala} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.description: Neutralize Glukhar 15 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Glukhar} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Glukhar} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.description: Neutralize Sanitar 15 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Sanitar} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Sanitar} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.description: Neutralize Kaban 15 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Kaban} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Kaban} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.displayName: I Hear the Voice of Darkness
achievements.description: Neutralize Knight 15 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Knight} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Knight} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.description: Neutralize Birdeye 15 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Birdeye} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Birdeye} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.description: Neutralize Big Pipe 15 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Big Pipe} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Big Pipe} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.description: Survive 10 consecutive raids while playing as a PMC
achievements.sortReason: Do it while counting PMC raids.
achievements.summary: Survive 10 raids in a row as a PMC.

guide.context: Dying resets the streak.

steps.text: Extract alive from 10 PMC raids without dying in between.

achievements.description: Neutralize every Boss once while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Eliminate every boss at least once as a PMC.

guide.context: Kills add up across raids.

steps.text: Kill each of the 13 bosses once: @enemy{Reshala}, @enemy{Killa}, @enemy{Tagilla}, @enemy{Shturman}, @enemy{Glukhar}, @enemy{Sanitar}, @enemy{Kaban}, @enemy{Kollontay}, @enemy{Zryachiy}, @enemy{Partisan}, @enemy{Knight}, @enemy{Birdeye} and @enemy{Big Pipe}.

achievements.description: Neutralize Kollontay 15 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Kollontay} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Kollontay} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.description: Neutralize Partisan 15 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Partisan} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Partisan} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.description: Complete all of Gunsmith series tasks
achievements.summary: Complete every task in Mechanic's Gunsmith series.

steps.text: Complete Mechanic's Gunsmith quests in order through Gunsmith Master - Part 13, building each gun to its listed specifications.

achievements.description: Resolve the issue with the BTR driver one way or another
achievements.summary: Finish one of two rival quests: The Price of Independence (BTR Driver) or Skier's Choose Your Friends Wisely.

guide.context: Skier's Choose Your Friends Wisely makes the Savior ending impossible. Take The Price of Independence if you plan to get Savior.

steps.text: Reach level 20, then take the Mechanic quest A Helping Hand (set on @loc{Woods}) to get introduced to the BTR Driver, and follow his quests up to the Discombobulate split.
Take one of the two rival quests: Skier's Choose Your Friends Wisely, or, from the BTR Driver, The Price of Independence.
Choose Your Friends Wisely: stay in one raid and transit from Customs into Reserve, then Woods, then Lighthouse. Kill 5 PMCs along the way and extract on Lighthouse.

The Price of Independence: pick up the Incriminating letter from the third-floor office of the northern industrial plant building on Customs, transit to Reserve and leave it on level 3 of the military headquarters (Black Bishop), move on to Woods and kill three targets of any kind, transit to Lighthouse, fire yellow flares at the train station and at the pier, kill 10 Scavs during the run, and extract on Lighthouse. Dying or extracting early resets the finished objectives, but not the letter pickup.

achievements.description: Go all in on the BEAR squad beyond the cordon and complete Skier's Profitable Venture task line
achievements.summary: Complete Skier's Profitable Venture line by finishing Consolation Prize.

steps.text: Do Skier's Profitable Venture (player level 61): hand over 15 Trijicon REAP-IR thermal scopes.
Do Profit Retention: give in 15 Physical Bitcoins along with 30 graphics cards.
Then finish Consolation Prize: extract alive from @loc{The Lab} 15 times and score 100 kills there.

achievements.description: Obliterate a cultist with the RShG-2 rocket launcher.
achievements.summary: Kill a cultist with an RShG-2 rocket launcher blast while playing as a PMC.

steps.text: Finish Prapor's Grenadier and The Art of Explosion, reach Prapor loyalty level 4, and buy an RShG-2.
Go into a night raid between 22:00 and 07:00 on Night Factory, Customs, Woods, Shoreline or Ground Zero (level 21+).
Find a cultist and kill one with a rocket blast, aiming near its feet.

achievements.description: Visit all locations in one raid as a PMC
achievements.sortReason: Do it after unlocking all maps.
achievements.summary: Visit every location in a single raid as a PMC.

guide.context: Bring roubles for the transfer area between maps. Death ends the run.

steps.text: Pick the Marathon option on the map selection screen. Ground Zero is chosen for you.

Ride the transits through these maps in sequence: Ground Zero, then Streets of Tarkov, then Interchange and Customs, then Factory and Woods, then Reserve, and finally Lighthouse. Some lists also place The Lab after Streets; take that transit too if the mode offers it.
Do not die or leave early. Extract on @loc{Shoreline} at the end.

achievements.description: Neutralize Killa 100 times while playing as a PMC
achievements.sortReason: Longest boss grind; do it with the other Killa kills.
achievements.summary: Eliminate @enemy{Killa} 100 times as a PMC.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Killa} on @loc{Interchange} in PMC raids until you reach 100 eliminations.

achievements.description: Meet Lightkeeper for the first time while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Talk to Lightkeeper in person for the first time on a PMC character.

steps.text: Finish Mechanic's Lightkeeper chain: Network Provider, the three Assessment quests, then Key to the Tower, then Knock-Knock, and last Getting Acquainted.
On @loc{Lighthouse}, cross the bridge with the encoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter on you. Do not hurt Zryachiy or his guards.
Talk to @npc{Lightkeeper} in the locked area on the lighthouse's 3rd level.

achievements.description: Neutralize every Boss without dying while playing as a PMC
achievements.sortReason: Final boss challenge after the single kills.
achievements.summary: Eliminate every boss as a PMC without dying.

guide.context: Plan a safe run and keep gear you can afford to lose.

steps.text: Kill all 13 bosses in the Long Live the King! list while staying alive; do not die until the last one is down.

achievements.description: Eliminate a PMC with a headshot while under the alcohol effect as a PMC.
achievements.summary: Headshot a PMC while you are affected by alcohol, playing as a PMC.

steps.text: Drink an alcoholic drink such as moonshine in a PMC raid, then kill a PMC with a headshot while the alcohol effect is active.

achievements.description: Search the office on Factory as a PMC.
achievements.summary: Search the office on Factory while playing as a PMC.

steps.text: Play a PMC raid on @loc{Factory} and search the office.

achievements.description: Eliminate Zryachiy 15 times as a PMC.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Zryachiy} 15 times in PMC raids.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Zryachiy} in PMC raids until you reach 15 eliminations. Raids do not need to be consecutive.

achievements.description: Eliminate any enemy while suffering from the Flash effect while playing as a PMC
achievements.summary: Eliminate any enemy while you have the Flash effect as a PMC.

steps.text: Bring flashbangs, flash yourself in a close fight on a tight map such as @loc{Factory}, and kill an enemy while the flash effect lasts.

achievements.description: Eliminate 4 PMC operatives with pistol headshots in a single raid as a PMC.
achievements.summary: Eliminate 4 PMC operatives with headshots using a pistol in one raid as a PMC.

steps.text: In one raid, kill 4 PMCs with headshots from a pistol. Revolvers do not count.

achievements.description: Eliminate a Scav while you play as a Scav.
achievements.summary: Kill a Scav while you are playing as a Scav.

steps.text: Start a raid as a Scav, then kill another Scav.

achievements.description: Eliminate a PMC with a headshot from more than 500 meters as a PMC.
achievements.summary: Land a headshot on a PMC from over 500 meters on a PMC character.

steps.text: Use a high-magnification scoped rifle on a long map such as @loc{Woods}, @loc{Lighthouse} or @loc{Shoreline} and shoot a PMC in the head from over 500 meters.

achievements.description: Earn Prestige level 1.
achievements.sortReason: Prestige resets the character, so it comes last.
achievements.summary: Earn Prestige level 1.

guide.context: Prestige restarts your character and keeps achievements. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost, so finish counters first.

steps.text: Reach PMC level 25 (PvE: 15), finish the New Beginning (Prestige 1) task, and have 10,000,000 roubles (PvE: 5,000,000). In the Hideout, build Intelligence Center 1, Nutrition Unit 2 and Rest Space 2.
Start the Prestige from the menu.

achievements.description: Earn Prestige level 2.
achievements.sortReason: Prestige resets the character, so it comes last.
achievements.summary: Earn Prestige level 2.

guide.context: Prestige restarts your character and keeps achievements. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost, so finish counters first.

steps.text: After Prestige 1, reach PMC level 30 (PvE: 25), finish New Beginning (Prestige 2) and Tour, have Strength and Endurance to 10 and Charisma to 7, build Intelligence Center 1, Nutrition Unit 2 and Rest Space 2 again, and have 15,000,000 roubles (PvE: 10,000,000).
Start the Prestige from the menu.

achievements.description: Earn Prestige level 3.
achievements.sortReason: Prestige resets the character, so it comes last.
achievements.summary: Earn Prestige level 3.

guide.context: Prestige restarts your character and keeps achievements. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost, so finish counters first.

steps.text: Reach PMC level 35, finish New Beginning (Prestige 3), Tour and Falling Skies, have Strength and Endurance at 10 and Charisma at 7, build Intelligence Center 1, Nutrition Unit 2 and Rest Space 2 again, and have 15,000,000 roubles.
Start the Prestige from the menu.

achievements.description: Earn Prestige level 4.
achievements.sortReason: Prestige resets the character, so it comes last.
achievements.summary: Earn Prestige level 4.

guide.context: Prestige restarts your character and keeps achievements. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost, so finish counters first.

steps.text: Reach PMC level 40, finish New Beginning (Prestige 4) and Tour, obtain the Ticket from Tarkov, have Strength and Endurance at 15 and Charisma at 12, build Intelligence Center 1, Nutrition Unit 2 and Rest Space 2 again, and have 15,000,000 roubles.
Start the Prestige from the menu.

achievements.description: Eliminate Zryachiy for the first time as a PMC.
achievements.summary: Eliminate @enemy{Zryachiy} for the first time as a PMC.

steps.text: In a PMC raid on @loc{Lighthouse}, find and kill @enemy{Zryachiy}. He guards the peninsula by the lighthouse with 2 guards; the guards can respawn up to 3 times while he lives.

achievements.description: Eliminate a hooded cultist with a cultist knife at night as a PMC.
achievements.summary: Eliminate one of the hooded cultists with a cultist knife at night as a PMC.

steps.text: Find a cultist knife, then hunt cultists in a night raid and kill one with that knife.

achievements.description: Find the crashed plane on Woods as a PMC.
achievements.summary: Reach the downed plane on Woods during a PMC raid.

steps.text: Play a PMC raid on @loc{Woods} and walk to the crashed plane on the eastern side.

achievements.description: Eliminate 7 PMC operatives in a single raid as a PMC.
achievements.summary: Eliminate 7 PMC operatives in one raid as a PMC.

steps.text: In one raid, kill 7 PMCs. Using a transit resets your count.

achievements.description: Survive a raid without a Run-through status for the first time.
achievements.summary: Survive a raid for the first time without the Run-through status.

guide.context: Leaving a raid too early marks it as a run-through and the raid does not count.

steps.text: Play a raid long enough that the Run-through status does not appear, then extract alive.

achievements.description: Complete Prapor's task to the end and give him the Armored case.
achievements.sortReason: Choice at the end of Falling Skies.
achievements.summary: Give Prapor the Armored case at the end of Falling Skies.

guide.context: This choice is final in a profile. Keeping the case gives Just Business instead, and only a new playthrough or Prestige gets the other one.

steps.text: Work through Falling Skies after Tour: find the fallen plane on @loc{Woods}, follow Prapor's requests, and retrieve the Armored case.
When asked to keep the case or hand it over, hand it to @npc{Prapor}.

achievements.description: Double-cross Prapor by keeping the Armored case.
achievements.sortReason: Choice at the end of Falling Skies.
achievements.summary: Keep the Armored case instead of giving it to Prapor at the end of Falling Skies.

guide.context: This choice is final in a profile. Giving the case gives Man of His Word instead, and only a new playthrough or Prestige gets the other one.

steps.text: Work through Falling Skies after Tour and retrieve the Armored case.
When asked to keep the case or hand it over, keep it.

achievements.description: Fully explore Tarkov and its inhabitants
achievements.sortReason: Opens the maps for everything else.
achievements.summary: Complete the Tour story chapter.

steps.text: Escape @loc{Ground Zero}, talk to @npc{Therapist} and make sure Streets of Tarkov opens. She may ask for 250,000 roubles.

Visit these traders in turn, each time extracting from the matching map or visiting it 3 times: Ragman (Interchange), Skier (Customs), Mechanic (Factory), Skier again (Woods, plus any 3 kills there), Prapor (Shoreline), Mechanic again (Lighthouse).
Where asked, hand over the extras: 5 found-in-raid building materials for Skier, 2 found-in-raid weapons for Mechanic, 5 PMC dogtags for Prapor, and 8,000 dollars for Mechanic.
Use the intercom at the port Terminal entrance to contact the garrison.
Reach @loc{The Lab} through the Factory or Streets entrance, search the top management offices and the server room, and leave by the drainage escape path.

achievements.description: Learn everything about the Blue Fire
achievements.summary: Complete the Blue Fire story chapter.

steps.text: Start by reading an EMERCOM leaflet or the Note by Item #1156: in the green container at the Woods EMERCOM camp, on the Interchange tents, in the ULTRA mall EMERCOM unit, or on the table in the Labyrinth prototype weapon area.
Talk to @npc{Mechanic}, get the device fragment from the LexOs dealership or Chekannaya 13, and hand it in.
Put the hacking device inside the Lab's server room, then make the fragment decision.

Read one Note mentioning Item #1156 on Ground Zero, Lighthouse or The Lab, investigate the Rus Post office, then open the Rus Post car with its key (one spawns on the ground by the back right wheel) and take the blueprint.

achievements.description: Find traces of a mysterious organization in Tarkov
achievements.summary: Complete The Unheard story chapter.

steps.text: Start by reading a Note with ramblings about the Purification at the TerraGroup security post or office on Streets of Tarkov, or office no. 4 in the TerraGroup building on Ground Zero.
Follow Mechanic's leads: Rzhevsky's service vehicle and hard drive, and the Blue Ice research papers.
Go to A.P.'s room, east wing room 305 of the Health Resort on @loc{Shoreline}. Take the flash drive from the laptop on the table and the TerraGroup corporate apartment key from the right nightstand.
In the Hideout, craft the decrypted flash drive at Intelligence Center level 1, then give it to Mechanic with 5,000,000 roubles.

After the wait, craft the reprogrammed keycard (the green one) at Intelligence Center level 1. Use it, along with the key from A.P.'s room, on the concealed door inside apartment 1 (second floor, Cardinal complex, Streets of Tarkov), and study the papers there.

achievements.description: Discover what the cultists were really after
achievements.summary: Complete the They Are Already Here story chapter.

steps.text: Begin by picking up and reading an Eye of the World note in a marked room on Customs, Reserve, Woods or Shoreline.
Kill a Cultist priest, then follow the Eye of the World marks on Customs, Streets, Reserve, Lighthouse, Woods and Shoreline.
At the ARRS station, restore power and cooling, install the flash drive, disconnect the station from outside agents, and restore its backup settings. Then collect the flash drive.
Hand the flash drive to Mechanic and read the ARRS specifications.

achievements.description: Learn what happened to Kozlov
achievements.summary: Complete the Accidental Witness story chapter.

steps.text: Begin at the car with white writing on it in the dorm courtyard on @loc{Customs}.
Find where Kozlov lived (dorm room 110), learn what he was involved in, and ask the traders about Anastasia.
Follow Skier and Ragman's leads on Streets of Tarkov to Anastasia's apartment and courier Pasha's ambush spot.
Search Reshala's stash on Customs, then find Kozlov's hideout and take his evidence.

achievements.description: Uncover the secret of The Labyrinth
achievements.summary: Complete The Labyrinth story chapter.

steps.text: Take the Labyrinth transit under the west wing of the health resort on @loc{Shoreline}; it requires the Knossos LLC facility key.
Question the traders about the underground facility, wait while Jaeger collects keycards, then trace the BEAR squad inside.
Play the tape from the locked office, deliver it to Jaeger, then read the research report left at the drain pipe beside the Shoreline pier.

achievements.description: Find out what happened to a certain BEAR squad
achievements.summary: Complete the Batya story chapter.

steps.text: Start by visiting a trace of the BEAR squad: the mattress on the Customs Scav base, the Reserve radar dome, the Shoreline bunker, or the Woods USEC camp rock.
Visit the Ryabina, Carousel and Gnezdo outposts and learn about the Bogatyr squad's members.
Reach Intelligence Center level 3, enter frequency 35.70 and then code 27.893.2000 on the radio, and gain access to @npc{Lightkeeper}.
Reach Light Machine Guns 5, Assault Rifles 10, Stress Resistance 10 and Strength 15, then get 15 kills without dying and 4 PMC kills without dying.
Contact Voevoda, then read the Agent network deployment report in Lightkeeper's area.

achievements.description: Refuse to fall for Mr. Kerman's schemes.
achievements.summary: Accept Kerman's offer, then refuse to deliver evidence to him.

guide.context: Each ending is a different choice in The Ticket, and only a new playthrough or Prestige gets the others.

achievements.description: Complete Prapor's tasks within three days.
achievements.sortReason: Part of the Survivor route with the case kept.
achievements.summary: Finish Prapor's three timed tasks in The Ticket within 72 hours.

guide.context: The 72 hour timer starts when Prapor gives the tasks. Missing it costs the Kappa container and this achievement.

steps.text: Keep the Armored case in Falling Skies, then refuse Kerman in The Ticket.
Prapor gives three tasks in order: get the TerraGroup evidence folders from The Lab, kill 50 targets on Streets of Tarkov, and kill 4 PMCs in one raid. Finish all three within 72 hours.

achievements.description: Refuse to sell the TerraGroup technology to Mechanic.
achievements.summary: Keep the Unknown device fragment instead of selling it to Mechanic in Blue Fire.

guide.context: This is a one-time choice in a profile. Handing over the fragment loses it until a new playthrough or Prestige.

steps.text: Start Blue Fire, get the device fragment from the LexOs dealership or Chekannaya 13, and give it to @npc{Mechanic}.
Put the hacking device into the first-floor server room of @loc{The Lab}.
Talk to Mechanic. When the choice comes up, keep the Item 1156 fragment for yourself.

achievements.description: Free Tarkov from the priests' eyes by completing They Are Already Here.
achievements.sortReason: Same chapter as Through Another's Eyes.
achievements.summary: Complete the They Are Already Here story chapter to free Tarkov from the priests' eyes.

steps.text: Complete They Are Already Here. The achievement unlocks with Through Another's Eyes at the end of the chapter.

achievements.description: Escape Tarkov by paying whatever it takes.
achievements.summary: Reach the Survivor ending by refusing Mr. Kerman and paying Prapor to leave Tarkov.

guide.context: Each ending is a different choice in The Ticket, and only a new playthrough or Prestige gets the others.

steps.text: During The Ticket, decline Mr. Kerman's job.
Pay Prapor 300,000,000 roubles if he already has the Armored case, or 500,000,000 roubles if you still hold it. When you held onto it, also finish his three tasks inside 72 hours.
Collect Prapor's letter, then launch the Terminal finale at the Shoreline intercom (21:00-06:00).

achievements.description: Escape Tarkov and fall into the darkness.
achievements.summary: Reach the Fallen ending by accepting Kerman, refusing to find dirt, and paying Prapor with the dangerous cargo.

guide.context: Each ending is a different choice in The Ticket, and only a new playthrough or Prestige gets the others.

steps.text: During The Ticket, say yes to Mr. Kerman's job, then turn him down when he wants you to dig up evidence on TerraGroup.
Deal with Prapor: if you held onto the Armored case earlier, he wants 50 military or advanced electronics items, plus one secure container (Theta, Epsilon or Kappa), plus 40 repair kits.
Hand Prapor the Case with dangerous cargo together with 1,000,000 dollars.
Collect the keycard carrying Prapor's hash codes, build Solar Power level 1, and launch the Terminal finale at the Shoreline intercom (21:00-06:00).

achievements.description: Escape Tarkov while staying bound to your debt.
achievements.summary: Reach the Debtor ending by handing in 2 major evidence items, then refusing and doing Lightkeeper's escape chain.

guide.context: Each ending is a different choice in The Ticket, and only a new playthrough or Prestige gets the others.

steps.text: During The Ticket, accept Kerman's job, agree to look for dirt, and hand over exactly 2 major evidence pieces.
When Kerman asks for more, refuse.

Work through Lightkeeper's chain: question every trader about leaving (Lightkeeper last), give him the military flash drive loaded with 5 topographic maps, kill 30 PMCs on Woods, and hand in 100 PMC dogtags.
Stash 6 Sacred Amulets (Customs, Streets x2, Reserve x3) in Lightkeeper's stash room on Lighthouse.
Buy Lightkeeper's RFID keycard for 1 TerraGroup Blue Folders material, then launch the Terminal finale at the Shoreline intercom (21:00-06:00).

achievements.description: Escape Tarkov and expose TerraGroup to save humanity.
achievements.sortReason: Final story choice; needs most chapters.
achievements.summary: Reach the Savior ending by exposing TerraGroup and escaping through the Terminal.

guide.context: Each ending is a different choice in The Ticket, and only a new playthrough or Prestige gets the others. You must have taken The Price of Independence, because Choose Your Friends Wisely closes this route; that quest gives +0.5 BTR Driver standing.

steps.text: During The Ticket, take Mr. Kerman's job and agree to collect evidence against TerraGroup.
Deliver eight of the nine major evidence items to Kerman. You need Intelligence Center level 3 for this.
Complete Fence's assignments: keep Scav karma above 4.0 and use the Friendship Bridge (Woods) and Scav Lands (Reserve) co-op extracts.
Raise your standing with the BTR Driver to 0.4, give Mechanic 40 Physical Bitcoins, and build Solar Power level 1.
Collect Kerman's hash-code keycard, then launch the Terminal finale at the Shoreline intercom (21:00-06:00), holding the evidence container Alpha-1.

achievements.description: Earn Prestige level 5.
achievements.sortReason: Prestige resets the character, so it comes last.
achievements.summary: Earn Prestige level 5.

guide.context: Prestige restarts your character and keeps achievements. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost, so finish counters first.

steps.text: Reach PMC level 47, finish New Beginning (Prestige 5), Tour, They Are Already Here and Collector, obtain the Ticket from Tarkov, raise Strength, Endurance and Charisma to 20, build Intelligence Center 2, Security 3 and Rest Space 3, and have 20,000,000 roubles.
Start the Prestige from the menu.

achievements.description: Earn Prestige level 6.
achievements.sortReason: Prestige resets the character, so it comes last.
achievements.summary: Earn Prestige level 6.

guide.context: Prestige restarts your character and keeps achievements. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost, so finish counters first.

steps.text: Reach PMC level 47, finish New Beginning (Prestige 6), Collector and The Ticket, have Strength, Endurance and Charisma to 20, have Intelligence Center 2, Security 3 and Rest Space 3 built again, and have 20,000,000 roubles.
Start the Prestige from the menu.

achievements.description: Decrypt The Unheard's data from the archives on the icebreaker Boreas.
achievements.summary: Decrypt The Unheard's data from the Icebreaker archive on the Boreas.

steps.text: Play Boreas until Mechanic wants help decoding the icebreaker drives. Bring him these found-in-raid items: 4 server RAM modules, 2 cryptographic processors and 3 Ultralink satellite modules.
Read the Icebreaker archive data from your messages in the handbook.

achievements.displayName: Part of the Ship, Part of the Crew
achievements.description: Learn every secret of the icebreaker Boreas.
achievements.summary: Complete Boreas, every Icebreaker side quest and enter every locked room on the Icebreaker.

steps.text: Start Boreas by obtaining a Paradigm Shipping poster or checking the distress signal at Intelligence Center level 3, then complete the chapter.
Finish every side quest given on the Icebreaker.
Open every locked room on the Icebreaker using the crew quarters, engine room, C-1 and C-3 keycards.

achievements.description: Neutralize 4 members of The Wedge's squad as a PMC.
achievements.summary: Kill four of The Wedge's squad on the @loc{Icebreaker} while playing as a PMC.

steps.text: Finish the Boreas chapter so the Icebreaker opens, and carry a Sudak-Tudak marine repair kit.
Enter @loc{Icebreaker} by transit from the Lighthouse or Shoreline pier. Direct selection opens after the quest Stick to It.
Kill 4 of The Wedge's squad. He is in the gym on level 3.

achievements.description: Neutralize 60 members of The Wedge's squad as a PMC.
achievements.summary: Kill sixty of The Wedge's squad on the @loc{Icebreaker} while playing as a PMC.

guide.context: Progress adds up across raids. Progress toward an unfinished achievement is lost if you Prestige.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Icebreaker} the same way: Boreas chapter done, Sudak-Tudak marine repair kit in hand, transit from the Lighthouse or Shoreline pier.
Kill The Wedge's followers or The Wedge himself on repeat raids until you reach 60.

steps.text: As a seasonal character, complete Lightkeeper's Season 1 task line.
For Historical Prospects, kill 3 PMCs between 22:00 and 08:00 on each of Customs, Woods and Streets of Tarkov, and leave 3 PMC dogtags at the marked drop spot on each of those maps.
